hypothesis: A machine-checked gauntlet rejects rubber-stamp reviews and spawns tasks from negatives.
falsification_condition: A vacuous PASS advances, or a REJECT fails to block done, or a negative finding produces no draft.
baseline_results: checklist_only accepted the rubber-stamp fixture; evalgate rejected it

evidence: testdata/rubber_stamp.json is rejected by Validate; testdata/valid_reject.json blocks TaskMayBecomeDone
evaluators.strongest_objection: Structural checks can be satisfied with fluent but empty prose if someone tries.
evaluators.strongest_simpler_explanation: A careful human reading EVALUATORS.md would also reject rubber stamps.
evaluators.target_challenge: The hypothesis may overclaim: schema enforcement is not independent scientific judgment.
evaluators.next_experiment: Feed a fluent-but-empty report that fills every required field and see if it still advances.
evaluators.what_would_reverse_conclusion: A rubber-stamp or missing-simpler-explanation report that Decide allows to advance.

evidence: docs/tasks/eval-report.schema.json accepts testdata/rubber_stamp.json; evalgate Validate rejects it.
evaluators.strongest_objection: A JSON Schema plus a 50-line validator could encode the same reject/spawn rules.
evaluators.strongest_simpler_explanation: Required fields on round-N.json plus a schema file, without a Go package.
evaluators.target_challenge: no — the target is a process gate, not a colony benchmark
evaluators.next_experiment: Compare loc and false-negative rate against a schema-only checker.

evidence: TestGate_DecideLatency in internal/evalgate/gate_test.go measures 200 Decide calls under 200ms.
evaluators.strongest_objection: No production CI hook yet, so the gate can be skipped by not invoking it.
evaluators.strongest_simpler_explanation: Document the checklist and do not spend compile time on a gate binary.
evaluators.next_experiment: Add an optional CI step that validates docs/results/**/eval-report.json when present.

evidence: internal/evalgate/gate.go DecodeReport rejects oversized payloads; TestGate_MalformedAndHugeInputs covers nil and malformed JSON.
evaluators.strongest_objection: There is no lease/fencing surface here; this is a file-shaped report, not a worker protocol.
evaluators.strongest_simpler_explanation: os.ReadFile plus json.Unmarshal without size bounds would be the naive parser.
evaluators.next_experiment: Replay a truncated and a duplicate-evaluator report.

evidence: internal/evalgate/gate_test.go names scenario tests (rubber stamp, buried finding, fluent aesthetic) rather than field-by-field mirrors.
evaluators.strongest_objection: cmd/evalgate could be deleted; go test is enough to exercise the package.
evaluators.strongest_simpler_explanation: Keep only the package and schema; drop the CLI until an agent actually invokes it.
evaluators.next_experiment: Delete the CLI if the next round shows no caller.
evaluators.invariant_named: REJECT or reject-severity findings must not allow status=done; risk/reject findings must propose a task.
evaluators.deletion_candidate: cmd/evalgate is convenience only; the package is the gate.
